title: Medya
canDo: Haber ve röportajlarda sorulan soruları, verilen emir ve rica cümlelerini dolaylı anlatımla aktarabilir, advise, warn, deny, accuse gibi aktarma fiillerini doğru kalıplarıyla kullanabilir ve bir röportajı haber diliyle özetleyebilirim.
grammar: dolaylı emir ve rica (told / asked sb (not) to)

liveClass.title: Basın toplantısı
liveClass.goal: Bir öğrenci ünlü bir kişiyi (sporcu, oyuncu, belediye başkanı) canlandırır, diğerleri gazeteci olarak soru sorar. Ardından her "gazeteci" röportajı aktarma fiilleriyle haberleştirir (The journalist asked whether..., She denied..., He promised to...). Gruplar haberlerini okur ve kimin en doğru ve en ilgi çekici aktarımı yaptığını tartışır.

lessons.title: Ne sordu?
lessons.goal: Evet-hayır sorularını ve soru kelimeli soruları dolaylı anlatımla doğru sözcük sırasıyla aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Bir röportajın perde arkası
discover.body:
Last week, our reporter interviewed the young chef Arda Yalın, whose restaurant has just won a major award.

First, she asked him how he had felt when he heard the news. He said he had been completely shocked.

She then asked whether he had always wanted to be a chef. He laughed and said that, as a child, he had wanted to be a footballer.

She also asked him what his favourite dish was and where he found his inspiration. Arda explained that his grandmother's cooking was his biggest influence.

Finally, she asked if he was planning to open a second restaurant. He refused to answer, but he smiled.

questions.prompt: What did Arda want to be as a child?
questions.explanation: "as a child, he had wanted to be a footballer"
"his grandmother's cooking was his biggest influence"

learn.explanation:
B1'de ifadeleri aktarmayı öğrendiniz. **Soruları** aktarırken iki önemli değişiklik olur:

**1. Soru sırası düz cümle sırasına döner** (yardımcı fiil ve do/does/did kalkar)

**2. Soru işareti kullanılmaz.**

**Evet-hayır soruları → ask + if / whether**

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| "**Are you** happy?" | She asked **if he was** happy. |
| "**Have you** always wanted to cook?" | She asked **whether he had** always wanted to cook. |
| "**Do you** like fish?" | She asked **if he liked** fish. |

**Soru kelimeli sorular → ask + soru kelimesi + özne + fiil**

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| "**What is** your favourite dish?" | She asked **what his favourite dish was**. |
| "**Where do you** find inspiration?" | She asked **where he found** inspiration. |
| "**How did you** feel?" | She asked **how he had felt**. |

**Zaman kaydırma** ve **zamir değişiklikleri** ifadelerdeki gibidir.

**Dikkat:** ~~She asked where did he find~~ / ~~She asked what was his favourite dish~~ (soru sırası korunmaz)

**Diğer fiiller:** **wanted to know** / **wondered** + if / wh-

examples.en: He asked me where I lived.
The interviewer asked whether I had any experience.
I wondered what time the shop closed.
examples.tr: Dükkânın saat kaçta kapandığını merak ettim.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede dolaylı soru yapısı ("nerede yaşadığımı sordu") düz cümle gibidir; İngilizcede de öyledir: He asked where I lived. Türkçe konuşanların sık hatası, soru sırasını korumaktır: "He asked where do I live" yanlıştır. Evet-hayır sorularında "-ıp -madığını" yapısı if / whether ile karşılanır.

options: She asked what was his name.

lessons.goal: Emir ve rica cümlelerini told / asked + kişi + (not) to ile aktarabilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Emir ve rica cümleleri** aktarılırken **to + yalın fiil** kullanılır. Zaman kaydırma gerekmez.

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| "**Check** every fact." | She **told me to check** every fact. |
| "**Don't post** anything." | She **told me not to post** anything. |
| "**Could you come** with me?" | She **asked me to come** with her. |
| "**Please don't be** late." | He **asked us not to be** late. |

**Yapı:** fiil + **kişi** + **(not) to** + yalın fiil

| Fiil | Ton |
|---|---|
| **tell** sb to | emir |
| **ask** sb to | rica |
| **order** sb to | resmî / askerî emir |
| **beg** sb to | yalvarma |
| **warn** sb (not) to | uyarı |
| **remind** sb to | hatırlatma |
| **advise** sb to | tavsiye |
| **encourage** sb to | cesaretlendirme |

**Dikkat:** "say" bu yapıyla kullanılmaz: ~~She said me to check~~ → She **told me to** check.

examples.en: The doctor told me to rest for a week.
My mum reminded me to take my keys.
The police warned people not to leave their homes.
examples.tr: Polis insanları evlerinden çıkmamaları için uyardı.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "gitmememi söyledi" yapısında olumsuzluk fiile eklenir. İngilizcede not, to'dan önce gelir: He told me not to go (~~He didn't tell me to go~~ farklı bir anlama gelir: Bana gitmemi söylemedi). "say" fiili bu yapıda kullanılamaz; tell, ask, warn gibi fiiller tercih edilmelidir.

lessons.title: Söz verdi, reddetti
lessons.goal: Aktarma fiillerini doğru kalıplarıyla (fiil + to, fiil + kişi + to) kullanarak söylenenlerin niyetini aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Belediye meclisinde gergin toplantı
discover.body:
Yesterday's city council meeting was one of the most heated in years.

The mayor promised to build three new parks before the end of her term. However, opposition councillors refused to support the plan, saying it was too expensive.

One councillor even threatened to take the issue to court. The mayor's team offered to publish the full budget online, and the opposition finally agreed to discuss the plan again next month.

Local residents who attended the meeting urged the council to make a decision quickly. One resident, a teacher, persuaded several councillors to visit her school, where there is no playground at all.

questions.explanation: "The mayor promised to build three new parks"

questions.prompt: What did the opposition agree to do?
options: Discuss the plan again next month
questions.explanation: "the opposition finally agreed to discuss the plan again next month"

learn.explanation:
**said** yerine **aktarma fiilleri** kullanmak, konuşanın **niyetini** de aktarır. Her fiilin kendi **kalıbı** vardır.

**1. Fiil + to + yalın fiil**

| Fiil | Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|---|
| **promise** | "I'll build three parks." | She **promised to build** three parks. |
| **refuse** | "No, I won't support it." | They **refused to support** it. |
| **offer** | "Shall I publish the budget?" | They **offered to publish** the budget. |
| **agree** | "OK, we'll discuss it." | They **agreed to discuss** it. |
| **threaten** | "I'll go to court!" | He **threatened to go** to court. |

**2. Fiil + kişi + to + yalın fiil**

| Fiil | Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|---|
| **urge** | "Please decide quickly!" | They **urged the council to decide**. |
| **persuade** | (ikna etti) | She **persuaded them to visit**. |
| **invite** | "Would you like to come?" | He **invited me to come**. |
| **encourage** | "Go on, try it!" | She **encouraged me to try**. |

**Olumsuz:** not to → He **promised not to tell** anyone.

examples.en: He offered to carry my bags.
She refused to answer the question.
My friends persuaded me to apply for the job.
examples.tr: Arkadaşlarım beni işe başvurmaya ikna etti.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "taşımayı teklif etti", "cevaplamayı reddetti" gibi yapılar "-mayı / -meyi" ile kurulur. İngilizcede bu fiiller to + yalın fiil alır: offered to carry, refused to answer. "He refused answering" ya da "He offered me carrying" yanlıştır.

lessons.title: İnkâr etti, suçladı
lessons.goal: -ing, that ve edat + -ing alan aktarma fiilleriyle (deny, admit, suggest, accuse of, apologise for) karmaşık ifadeleri aktarabilirim.

lines.speaker: Presenter
lines.text: Breaking news: the football club's president has been accused of hiding financial information.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: That's right. At this morning's press conference, he denied doing anything illegal.

lines.speaker: Presenter
lines.text: Did he admit making any mistakes?

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He admitted that the club's accounts had not been checked properly, and he apologised for not being more careful.

lines.speaker: Reporter

options: That the president should step down
That the club should be sold
questions.explanation: "suggested that the president should step down"

learn.explanation:
**3. Fiil + -ing**

| Fiil | Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|---|
| **deny** | "I didn't do it." | He **denied doing** it. |
| **admit** | "Yes, I made a mistake." | He **admitted making** a mistake. |
| **suggest** | "Let's meet at six." | She **suggested meeting** at six. |
| **recommend** | "You should try the fish." | He **recommended trying** the fish. |

**4. Fiil + (kişi) + edat + -ing**

| Fiil | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **accuse** sb **of** | They **accused him of hiding** information. |
| **apologise for** | He **apologised for being** late. |
| **insist on** | She **insisted on paying**. |
| **blame** sb **for** | They **blamed me for losing** the keys. |
| **thank** sb **for** | She **thanked us for coming**. |
| **congratulate** sb **on** | We **congratulated her on winning**. |

**5. Fiil + that + cümle** (birçok fiil bu kalıbı da alır)

- He **admitted that** the accounts had not been checked.
- She **suggested that** he **should** step down. (suggest + -ing **veya** that + should)

**Dikkat:** ~~suggest someone to do~~ yanlıştır: She suggested **that I** (should) **go** / She suggested **going**.

examples.en: The minister denied knowing about the plan.
examples.tr: Bakan plandan haberi olduğunu inkâr etti.

examples.en: She accused me of reading her messages.
He suggested that we should take a break.

learn.turkishNote: "Bana gitmemi önerdi" cümlesini "He suggested me to go" diye çevirmek Türkçe konuşanların çok sık yaptığı bir hatadır. suggest kişi + to almaz: He suggested going / He suggested that I (should) go. Aynı şekilde "accuse" fiili "of" ile kullanılır: accused him of lying (~~accused him for lying~~).

lessons.title: Röportajdan habere
lessons.goal: Bir röportajı aktarma fiilleri ve dolaylı anlatımla, haber üslubunda tarafsız ve doğru bir şekilde özetleyebilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Bir röportajı haberleştirirken:**

1. **Soruları** dolaylı anlatımla aktarın: *She was asked whether she had expected ...*
2. **Cevapları** niyeti gösteren fiillerle aktarın: *She **admitted** that ... / She **denied** ...*
3. **Tavsiye ve emirleri** to ile aktarın: *She **advised** young people **not to wait** ...*
4. Gerekirse kısa **doğrudan alıntılar** ekleyin: *"Start small," she said.*

**Gazetecilik dilinde sık kullanılan fiiller:**

| Fiil | Kullanım |
|---|---|
| **claim** (that) | iddia etmek (kanıt olmayabilir) |
| **state** (that) | resmî olarak belirtmek |
| **reveal** (that) | ortaya çıkarmak, açıklamak |
| **confirm** (that) | doğrulamak |
| **point out** (that) | dikkat çekmek |
| **add** (that) | eklemek |

**Passive aktarma** (haber dili):

- She **was asked** whether ... (Ona ... sorulduğunda)
- Melis, **who was interviewed** last week, ...

**Tarafsızlık:** Gazeteci kendi fikrini değil, kaynağın söylediklerini aktarır. **claim** kelimesi, iddianın doğrulanmadığını ima eder.

examples.en: The company claimed that the product was completely safe.
examples.tr: Şirket ürünün tamamen güvenli olduğunu iddia etti.

examples.en: She revealed that she had been offered a job in Hollywood.
When asked about her plans, she refused to give details.

learn.turkishNote: Türk basınında "... dedi", "... ifade etti", "... kaydetti" gibi fiiller sık kullanılır. İngilizce haber dilinde de benzer çeşitlilik vardır: said, stated, claimed, revealed, added. "claim" kelimesi Türkçedeki "iddia etti" gibi tarafsız ama temkinli bir ton taşır; söylenen şeyin doğru olduğunu garanti etmez.

task.prompt: Yukarıdaki Melis röportajını bir gazete haberi olarak yazın (160–200 kelime). Bir manşetle başlayın. Soruları dolaylı anlatımla, cevapları en az 6 farklı aktarma fiiliyle (admit, deny, promise, advise, reveal, claim, point out...) aktarın ve en az bir kısa doğrudan alıntı ekleyin.
task.modelAnswer:
YOUNG FOUNDER DENIES DATA CLAIMS

Melis Aydın, the 26-year-old founder of the recycling app GreenStep, has denied selling her users' personal data.

In an interview with our newspaper, Ms Aydın was asked whether she had ever expected her app to become so successful. She admitted that she had never imagined it would reach 2 million users. She revealed that the app had started as a simple university project.

When asked about recent criticism that the app collects too much information, Ms Aydın was firm. She insisted that the company did not sell any data, and she promised to publish a full privacy report next month. She pointed out that the app had been checked by independent experts last year.

Finally, she was asked what advice she would give to young people who want to start a business. She advised them not to wait for the perfect idea. "Start small, and listen to your users," she said.

The privacy report will be published in early June.
rubric: En az 6 aktarma fiili doğru kalıplarla

Hayali bir basın toplantısında sorulan soruları ve verilen cevapları dolaylı anlatımla aktarın; en az 6 farklı aktarma fiili (claim, deny, admit, apologise for, promise, urge, confirm...) kullanın.
questions.modelAnswer:
PHONE MAKER RECALLS 50,000 DEVICES

Technology company NovaTel has confirmed that it is recalling 50,000 smartphones after several reports of batteries overheating.

At a press conference yesterday, the company's director, Murat Kaya, was asked how many customers had been affected. He revealed that around 30 cases had been reported, but he insisted that nobody had been seriously hurt.

When journalists asked whether the company had known about the problem for months, Mr Kaya denied hiding any information. However, he admitted that the first tests had not been carried out carefully enough, and he apologised for causing customers so much worry.

Mr Kaya promised to replace every faulty phone free of charge within two weeks. He also urged customers to stop using the phone immediately and to contact the company's customer service.

Some consumer groups claimed that the company had acted too slowly. One expert pointed out that similar problems had been reported in other countries last year.

The company's share price fell by 8% after the announcement.
